sections.text:
Ability Power 160. Damages all enemies 2 times with magic water damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in skill level.
-Casts Karma on all enemies.
-Curses all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Removes continuous heal effects from all enemies.
-Removes attack speed boosting and Cost recovery speed effects from all enemies.
- Removes status ailments from all allies.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Unison gauge of all allies excluding yourself by 20.
[Additional Unison Effect] Casts Piercer on all allies for 60 seconds.
